candidate_windows.window_text: In this section, we will introduce our experimental datasets, baselines, and implementation details.

We initialize the BERT of RoCEL using BERTlarge-uncased with 340M parameters. We employ the Adam (Kingma and Ba, 2015) optimizer with

batch_size=16. We train the warm-up tasks with a learning rate of $2 \times 10^{-3}$ for 4 epochs, and the entity linking task with a learning rate of $2 \times 10^{-5}$ for 4 epochs. For model input, we use a maximum context length of 32 tokens. For Llama-3, we conduct experiments on a single 80GB A800 GPU, while for other models, we use four 32GB V100 GPUs. Hyper-parameters are determined through grid search. Experimental results are averaged over 3 different random seeds.
